name: Ana Krpo
story: Ana Krpo's 2004 Auckland University of Technology master's research developed a GIS model for runoff and contaminant loads in the Puhinui catchment, Manukau. The research used mapped catchment conditions and land-use scenarios to examine stormwater-management questions. The degree and research topic are documented in the thesis source; her subsequent career is not established.
